2608.30520.title: Learning-Assisted Congestion-Aware Route Scheduling for Semiconductor Fab Material Control Systems
2608.30520.paper_summary: Automated material handling systems in semiconductor fabs are operated by a material control system (MCS) that must schedule a relay route for every transport command online, before execution. This is a data-driven scheduling problem in which route cost is dominated in the upper tail by queueing at heterogeneous, partially observable relay equipment, so route selection requires estimating both delivery time and congestion risk at the decision moment. This paper proposes a transport-network-aware dynamic congestion representation (TN-DCR). Built on a static directed transport graph induced by historically observed relay segments, TN-DCR combines structural route priors, multi-window network-wide congestion context, route-level bottleneck exposure, and an inductive graph-aware route embedding, all constructed under a prediction-time-safety invariant that admits only information observed strictly before the prediction moment. The representation feeds separate queue- and transfer-time regressors and an ordinal multi-label classifier producing calibrated multi-threshold exceedance scores, with an empirical-Bayes stock-key residual correction reducing systematic queue-time underprediction. The predictions serve as costs in a risk-constrained route-scheduling rule that minimizes predicted delivery time subject to a bound on extreme-congestion probability, embedding the learned predictors within a lightweight operations-research decision model. In a controlled closed-loop evaluation, mean delivery time falls by 16.4\% and internal resource waiting time by 22.6\% while throughput remains essentially unchanged.
2608.30520.paper_summary_zh: 自動化物料處理系統在半導體製造廠由物料控制系統 (MCS) 操作，該系統必須在線上為每個運輸命令排定中繼路徑，然後再執行。這是一個數據驅動的排程問題，其中路徑成本在上尾部由異質、部分可觀察的中繼設備的排隊主導，因此路徑選擇需要在決策時刻估計交付時間和擁堵風險。本文提出了一種運輸網絡感知的動態擁堵表示 (TN-DCR)。TN-DCR 建立在由歷史觀察到的中繼段誘導的靜態有向運輸圖上，結合了結構性路徑先驗、多窗口網絡範圍擁堵上下文、路徑級瓶頸暴露和一種歸納圖感知的路徑嵌入，所有這些都是在一個預測時間安全不變的框架下構建的，該框架僅接受在預測時刻之前嚴格觀察到的信息。該表示為獨立的排隊和轉移時間回歸模型以及一個產生經過校準的多閾值超越分數的序數多標籤分類器提供輸入，並且經驗貝葉斯庫存關鍵殘差校正減少系統性排隊時間的低估。這些預測作為風險約束路徑排程規則中的成本，該規則最小化預測交付時間，同時限制極端擁堵概率，將學習到的預測器嵌入輕量級運營研究決策模型中。在一個受控的閉環評估中，平均交付時間下降了 16.4\%，內部資源等待時間下降了 22.6\%，而吞吐量基本保持不變。
